description: Searches VEDUTUM’s published articles, service pages and feature documentation (German or English) and returns titles, short answers and links. Use for questions about architectural visualisation: floor plan to 3D, rendering costs and resolutions, IFC and CAD formats, sign-off with clients, AI labelling of images.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

query.description: Search words, e.g. "Grundriss in 3D umwandeln" or "rendering resolution print"

name: vedutum_search_knowledge
title: Search VEDUTUM articles, services and feature pages
